rawText: Gaslini Alberti - Badia di Morrona - Rosso della Badia - Particolare decoro mattonella Secolo XV - Dalla collezione della famiglia Gaslini Alberti - Toscana Indicazione Geografica Tipica Rosso
description: Badia di Morrona is a Tuscan estate near Terricciola in the Pisan hills, owned by the Gaslini Alberti family, whose origins as a monastic property date back centuries. Rosso della Badia is an entry-level IGT Toscana blend, typically based on Sangiovese with Merlot, aimed at everyday drinking rather than long ageing.
